name: contexttop-vscode
description: Live GitHub Copilot context observability and fixes.

commands.title: contextTop: Enable Copilot Agent Debug Log (OTLP)

contextTop.warningThreshold.description: Estimated context pressure (fraction of observed budget) at which ContextTop Fix surfaces a warning.

contextTop.warnTokens.description: Absolute candidate-token level at which the live chart turns amber (warning zone).

contextTop.criticalTokens.description: Absolute candidate-token level at which the live chart turns red (critical zone).

contextTop.timeWindowMinutes.description: Time span shown on the live chart, in minutes. Also settable from the panel.

contextTop.captureLevel.description: What may be stored locally: nothing, metrics only, or metrics plus short-lived redacted detail.

contextTop.allowTransientContentProcessi.description: Allow bounded raw source content into the local engine for tokenization and redaction. Disabling forces coarser size-based estimates. Never enables persistence.

contextTop.enableDiagnosticLogs.description: Opt in to parsing validated GitHub Copilot trace logs for request lifecycle, selected model, and context breakdown.

contextTop.detailRetentionHours.description: Hours to retain optional redacted-detail records before automatic deletion (max 7 days).

contextTop.measurementRetentionDays.description: Days to retain source measurements and request snapshots.

contextTop.rollupRetentionDays.description: Days to retain hourly aggregate rollups.

contextTop.maxStorageMiB.description: Hard cap on local contextTop storage before oldest data is evicted.

contextTop.dashboardLayout.markdownDescription: Which dashboard cards to show and in what order. Cards omitted from the list are hidden. Available cards: `story`, `request`, `requestBreakdown`, `gauges`, `chart`, `sources`, `analytics`, `actions`.
